harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed a Python stdlib inventory web app (JSON API on /, /inventory, /healthz) on node2 and node3, each running as a systemd service (inventory-app.service) on port 8080, with firewalld opened for 8080. Installed and configured nginx on node1 as an HTTP load balancer (upstream round-robin) listening on port 80, forwarding to node2:8080 and node3:8080, with the stock default nginx server block disabled to avoid a port-80 conflict, SELinux httpd_can_network_connect enabled to permit proxying, and firewalld opened for the http service. Verified round-robin distribution across both backends. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured a healthy baseline (boot_id, active services, HTTP 200) on all three nodes, sequentially rebooted node1, node2, then node3 one at a time via systemctl reboot, polled each until reachable again, confirmed each node's boot_id changed, and confirmed inventory-app.service (node2/node3) and nginx (node1) were active again with the load balancer correctly alternating between both healthy backends after every restart.
actions_performed: Inspected all three nodes (OS, existing inventory app, python3/firewalld/nginx availability)
Wrote /opt/inventory-app/app.py (Python stdlib HTTP server on 8080 serving JSON inventory + /healthz) to node2 and node3 via base64 transfer
Created and enabled inventory-app.service (systemd) on node2 and node3, opened firewalld port 8080/tcp on both
Verified backends reachable from node1 over the network
Installed nginx on node1 via dnf
Created /etc/nginx/conf.d/inventory-lb.conf with upstream inventory_backend (node2:8080, node3:8080) and a port-80 proxy server block
Disabled the conflicting stock default server block in /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
Enabled httpd_can_network_connect SELinux boolean to allow nginx to reach the backends (fixed 502 Permission denied errors)
Enabled/started nginx and opened firewalld http service on node1
Reloaded nginx to clear stale upstream failure state and verified round-robin load balancing via repeated curl requests
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id, active services, HTTP 200) on node1, node2, node3
Sequentially rebooted node1, then node2, then node3 with systemctl reboot, polling each until reachable
Verified changed boot_id and recovered services/LB health after each individual node restart

evidence.requirement: Inventory app running on node2:8080
evidence.summary: inventory-app.service enabled+active on node2, firewall port 8080 opened, /healthz returns {"status": "ok", "server": "node2"}

evidence.requirement: Inventory app running on node3:8080
evidence.summary: inventory-app.service enabled+active on node3, firewall port 8080 opened, /healthz returns {"status": "ok", "server": "node3"}

evidence.requirement: node1 load-balances HTTP on port 80 across both backends
evidence.summary: curl loop against node1 port 80 alternates responses between server:node2 and server:node3, confirming nginx upstream round-robin

evidence.requirement: node1 nginx installation and config validity
evidence.summary: nginx installed via dnf; nginx -t syntax check passes after disabling conflicting default server block

evidence.requirement: Root cause fix for initial 502 errors (SELinux)
evidence.summary: getenforce=Enforcing and httpd_can_network_connect=off explained 502s; error log showed 'Permission denied' connecting to upstreams, confirming SELinux was the cause

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline
evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot_id 54089086-... captured, nginx active, curl returns HTTP 200

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot acknowledged (stream closed), node1 later reachable again with new boot_id 620a392e-... (differs from baseline)

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: recovered state
evidence.summary: nginx active again post-reboot and load-balanced responses alternate between node2/node3 as before

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline
evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot_id 8c28f3cd-... captured, inventory-app.service active, /healthz returns ok

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot acknowledged (stream closed), node2 later reachable again with new boot_id 6482848a-... (differs from baseline)

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: recovered state
evidence.summary: inventory-app.service active again, /healthz ok, and node1 LB confirms node2 is back in rotation

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline
evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot_id e65e6bcf-... captured, inventory-app.service active, /healthz returns ok

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot acknowledged (stream closed), node3 later reachable again with new boot_id 2a8ddd8f-... (differs from baseline)

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: recovered state and full cluster health
evidence.summary: inventory-app.service active again on node3, /healthz ok, and node1 LB round-robins correctly across both node2 and node3 after all three restarts
